notes: Built by build_campaign_aggregate_highNoise.py from existing sweep_8qubit_highNoise.py output; no re-simulation was done.

This is the high-noise variant campaign: PAULI_SCHEDULE = [0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02, 0.01, 0.0] (2x the gate-error probability of the base commeff_tfim_8qubit_20260624_182713 campaign, whose schedule is [0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01, 0.005, 0.0]). Everything else (Hamiltonians, ground energies, n_gates, circuit ansatz, 8 own methods, 100 seeds) is identical between the two source scripts (confirmed via direct diff of sweep_8qubit.py vs sweep_8qubit_highNoise.py).

normalized_gap uses span=2*|ground| (sweep_8qubit_highNoise.py's own approximation), matching the reference targeted_tfim_8qubit pipeline's (top_energy-ground_energy) formula to ~7 significant figures for these Hamiltonians.

No grad_norm/lambda_min/lambda_max/secondary_kind/trap_score/paper_trapped: these require final circuit parameters which were never saved to disk by either pipeline (computed in-memory then discarded).
No 'random' target_selection_mode: this variant does not exist in sweep_8qubit_highNoise.py.

shot_100 (9th method) is a BORROWED baseline: its 500 rows (5 Hamiltonians x 100 seeds) were copied as-is from D:\yujin\targeted_tfim_8qubit (the reference method_suite campaign), not generated by sweep_8qubit_highNoise.py. It does not use pauli_schedule at all (finite-shot measurement noise, not gate noise), so the high-noise-vs-normal-schedule difference between the two pipelines does not apply to it -- the same borrowed rows used for the base campaign were reused here unchanged. Per-seed pairing with the other 8 methods is not guaranteed (independent codebases may seed initial circuit parameters differently) -- treat shot_100 comparisons as aggregate-level (rate/mean/median across the 500 rows), not as a seed-matched paired comparison.
No target_masks/: per-seed selected-gate masks were not reconstructed (available on request from eff_scores.json).
No diverged (NaN/inf) rows were found in this dataset (checked directly across all 5 Hamiltonians x 100 seeds x 8 own methods before building this aggregate).

Caveat: at the time this aggregate was built (2026-07-16), the source directory was being actively re-run in place by run_h_seeds_highNoise.py (5 parallel drivers, one per Hamiltonian, iterating seed 0-99 again with no resume/skip logic -- config.json/detailed_results.csv per seed are only rewritten once all 8 methods finish for that seed). The values consumed here for the seeds still in flight (seed 83/72/75/75/86 for H00000-H00004 respectively, at build time) are therefore each seed's last-fully-completed run, not the in-progress rerun. Spot-checked determinism (same seed, same hardcoded Hamiltonian, same optimizer, no external randomness) confirms the rerun reproduces bit-identical final energies for every stage checked so far, so this aggregate should not need to be rebuilt once the rerun finishes -- but rebuild it anyway once run_h_seeds_highNoise.py prints 'ALL DONE' for all 5 Hamiltonians, to be safe.
